locator: Inline Supplementary Table 3 (mmc3.docx), row 'Frontal Lobe' / 'right', columns PI-EA B (se) and PI-LA B (se)
evidence: Both contrasts print the same SE, 1814.88. The ratio SE(PI-EA)/SE(PI-LA) is fixed by the design matrix (same subjects and covariates in every lobar model), and it is 1.0234 in all seven other lobar rows of this table (1.0242 in the four hippocampus/amygdala rows, which use 157 subjects; 1.0530 in all eight rows of Inline Supplementary Table 4). The right frontal row alone gives 1.0000, so one of its two SEs is probably a duplicated cell. If PI-EA's 1814.88 is right, PI-LA's would be ~1773.3; if PI-LA's is right, PI-EA's would be ~1857.4. Which cell is wrong cannot be decided from the paper. Both B estimates remain significant either way.
